blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sentiment analysis is a fundamental problem in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Standard sentiment classification for the Arabic language remains challenging due to the high volume of dialectal Arabic. To advance research in this area, this paper proposes the Shared Task on Sentiment Analysis and Swapping in Arabic Dialects (DialectSentEval), hosted with the Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026). This shared task consists of two subtasks: Subtask 1 focuses on multi-class and multi-dialect sentiment analysis, requiring models to identify sentiment polarity across various Arabic dialects. Subtask 2 introduces a generative task for Arabic sentiment swap, challenging models to invert sentiment polarity while preserving core semantics. In this overview paper, we present the motivation, dataset creation, and summarize the main findings from participating models.
blocks.zh: 感官分析是自然语言处理(NLP)中的一个基本问题. 由于阿拉伯语方言量大,阿拉伯语的标准情绪分类仍然具有挑战性。 为推动这一领域的研究,本文件提议与阿拉伯语自然语言处理会议(阿拉伯语NLP 2026)共同主办的 " 关于阿拉伯文糖尿病的感知分析和振荡的共同任务 " 。 这一共同的任务由两个分任务组成: 第1分任务侧重于多等和多分辨的情绪分析,需要模型识别跨越各种阿拉伯语方言的情绪极性. 子任务2引入了阿拉伯语情绪互换的基因化任务,挑战模式在保留核心语义的同时倒置情绪极性. 在这份概览文件中,我们介绍了动机、数据集的创建情况,并总结了参与模型的主要结果。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sentiment analysis remains a key task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), with critical real-world applications ranging from social media monitoring to customer feedback analysis. While significant progress has been made for many languages, and multiple types have been defined (document, sentence, and feature/aspect level), the Arabic language presents unique challenges due to its rich morphology and extensive dialectal variation. Most user-generated content, the primary source for sentiment data, is written in dialectal Arabic, which is often under-resourced and differs significantly from Modern Standard Arabic (MSA).
blocks.zh: 感知分析仍然是自然语言处理(NLP)中的一项关键任务,关键的现实世界应用从社交媒体监测到客户反馈分析. 虽然在许多语言方面已经取得重大进展,并界定了多种类型(文件、句子和特征/示意图级别),但阿拉伯语由于其丰富的形态和广泛的方言差异而提出了独特的挑战。 大部分用户生成的内容是情绪数据的主要来源,是用方言阿拉伯语写成的,这常常是资源不足的,与现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA)有很大不同.

blocks.en: To address these challenges and foster innovation in Arabic NLP, we propose a novel Shared Task on Sentiment Analysis and Swapping in Arabic Dialects (DialectSentEval), hosted with the Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026) 1 1 1 https://ezzini.github.io/DialectSentEval/ . This task is designed to move beyond standard sentiment classification by evaluating both the understanding and generation of sentiment in diverse Arabic contexts. DialectSentEval comprises two distinct but complementary subtasks:
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战和促进阿拉伯NLP的创新,我们提议在阿拉伯语自然语言处理会议(阿拉伯语NLP 2026)期间,推出一个名为 " 阿拉伯文语言感知分析和振荡共同任务 " (DialectSentEval)的新型出版物。 这项任务旨在超越标准情绪分类,评价在不同的阿拉伯语背景下对情绪的理解和产生。 DialectSentEval包括两个不同但相互补充的子任务:

blocks.en: • Subtask 1: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis : A multi-class classification task focused on identifying the sentiment (positive, negative, or neutral) of texts written in various Arabic dialects. This subtask emphasizes the need for robust models that can handle the lexical and syntactic diversity of the Arab world. • Subtask 2: Arabic Sentiment Swap : A generative task where participants’ systems must rewrite a given sentence to invert its sentiment polarity (e.g., positive to negative) while preserving its core meaning. This challenges models to go beyond surface-level cues and demonstrate a deeper grasp of semantics and syntax.
blocks.zh: • 第1分任务:阿拉伯语糖尿病感知分析:一个多类分类任务,重点是确定用各种阿拉伯语方言编写的文字的情绪(正、负或中)。 这一子任务强调,需要能够处理阿拉伯世界词汇和合成多样性的有力模型。 · 次级任务2:阿拉伯语感应交换:一项遗传性任务,参与者的系统必须改写某一句子来颠倒其情绪极性(如正向负向),同时保留其核心意义。 这种挑战模式超越了地表平面提示,展现出更深入地把握语义和语法.

blocks.en: Subtask 1: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis : A multi-class classification task focused on identifying the sentiment (positive, negative, or neutral) of texts written in various Arabic dialects. This subtask emphasizes the need for robust models that can handle the lexical and syntactic diversity of the Arab world.
blocks.zh: 第1分任务:阿拉伯语糖尿病感知分析:一个多类分类任务,重点是确定用各种阿拉伯语方言写成的文字的情绪(正、负或中)。 这一子任务强调,需要能够处理阿拉伯世界词汇和合成多样性的有力模型。

blocks.en: Subtask 2: Arabic Sentiment Swap : A generative task where participants’ systems must rewrite a given sentence to invert its sentiment polarity (e.g., positive to negative) while preserving its core meaning. This challenges models to go beyond surface-level cues and demonstrate a deeper grasp of semantics and syntax.
blocks.zh: 子任务2:阿拉伯语感想交换 : 一项基因任务,参与者的系统必须重写一个特定的句子来颠倒其情绪的极性(如正向负向),同时保留其核心意义. 这种挑战模式超越了地表平面提示,展现出更深入地把握语义和语法.

blocks.en: 2 Motivation
blocks.zh: 2 动机

blocks.en: The motivation for DialectSentEval is grounded in both linguistic and methodological gaps in current Arabic NLP research.
blocks.zh: DialectSentEval的动机基于目前阿拉伯NLP研究的语言和方法上的差距.

blocks.en: First, despite sustained interest in sentiment analysis for Arabic, there remains a clear shortage of robust benchmarks that adequately capture dialectal diversity. Earlier shared tasks and evaluation campaigns ( El-Beltagy et al., 2017 ; Rosenthal et al., 2017 ) have advanced sentiment classification for Arabic, yet most resources are either limited to MSA or focus on a narrow set of dialects and domains El-Haj (2026) ; El-Haj (2020) . In practice, however, the majority of user-generated content, including reviews, social media posts, and online discussions, is written in dialectal Arabic. These dialects exhibit substantial lexical, morphological, and syntactic variation, which often leads to performance degradation when models trained on MSA are applied to real-world data. Prior work has highlighted the fragmentation of Arabic sentiment resources and the difficulty of transferring models across dialects ( Nwesri et al., 2025 ; Alwakid et al., 2022 ) , reinforcing the need for more representative evaluation benchmarks. By introducing a balanced, multi-dialect benchmark informed by recent benchmarking efforts ( Alharbi et al., 2025c ) , DialectSentEval seeks to promote the development of sentiment models that generalise across dialects and better reflect authentic language use in the Arab world.
blocks.zh: 第一,尽管对阿拉伯语的情绪分析一直感兴趣,但明显缺乏充分反映方言多样性的有力基准。 早期分担的任务和评价运动(El-Beltagy等,2017;Rosenthal等,2017)对阿拉伯语有先进的情感分类,然而大多数资源要么仅限于MSA,要么侧重于狭义的方言和域名El-Haj(2026);El-Haj(2020). 但实际上,大多数用户生成的内容,包括评论,社交媒体帖子,以及在线讨论,都是用方言阿拉伯语写的. 这些方言呈现出大量的词汇、形态和合成变异,在经过管理事务协议培训的模型应用于现实世界数据时,往往导致性能退化。 先前的工作突出了阿拉伯语情绪资源分散的问题,以及跨方言转让模型的困难(Nwesri等,2025年;Alwakid等,2022年),这进一步证明需要有更具代表性的评价基准。 DialecticSentEval采用了一个平衡的、多角度的基准,以最近的基准工作为依据(Alharbi等,2025年c),力求促进各种方言的情绪模式的发展,更好地反映阿拉伯世界的真实语言使用。

blocks.en: Second, the task aims to extend evaluation beyond classification into controlled text generation. While sentiment classification has reached a relatively mature stage in Arabic NLP, generative sentiment manipulation remains underexplored ( Abudalfa et al., 2025 ) . Sentiment swapping, framed as a form of style transfer, requires systems to invert polarity while preserving core propositional content. This problem has been investigated in English ( Shen et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2018 ) , where style transfer research has demonstrated the complexity of disentangling content from sentiment and other stylistic attributes. Comparable resources and systematic evaluation frameworks are scarce for Arabic, limiting progress in controllable generation Abudalfa et al. (2024) ; Abdu et al. (2025) . The limited availability of high-quality parallel datasets has constrained progress in this area. By introducing a dedicated sentiment swap subtask, DialectSentEval encourages research on semantic preservation, polarity control, and evaluation methodologies for Arabic natural language generation. Such capabilities have practical implications for data augmentation, controllable dialogue systems, and adaptive content generation, particularly in low-resource and dialectally diverse settings.
blocks.zh: 第二,这项任务旨在将评价范围扩大到控制下文本生成。 虽然情绪分类在阿拉伯语NLP中已达到了相对成熟的阶段,但基因情感操纵仍未得到充分的探讨(Abudalfa等,2025年)。 感想互换(Sentiment switching),被设定为风格转移的一种形式,需要系统在保留核心命题内容的同时进行倒极. 这个问题在英语(Shen等,2017;Li等,2018)中被调查,其风格转移研究已经证明了脱落内容与情感和其他花样属性的复杂性. 对阿拉伯语而言,可比较的资源和系统评价框架稀缺,限制了在可控制的一代Abudalfa等人(2024年);Abdu等人(2025年)方面的进展。 高质量并行数据集的提供有限,限制了这一领域的进展。 DialectSentEval通过引入一个专门的情绪交换子任务,鼓励研究阿拉伯语自然语言生成的语义保护、极性控制和评价方法。 这种能力对数据扩充、可控制的对话系统和适应性内容生成具有实际影响,特别是在资源和方言多样性的环境中。

blocks.en: By combining a dialect-aware classification task with a challenging generative task, DialectSentEval offers a unified benchmark for both sentiment understanding and sentiment manipulation in Arabic. This dual focus is intended to stimulate research that moves beyond surface-level polarity detection towards more semantically grounded and controllable language technologies for Arabic.
blocks.zh: DialecticSentEval通过将一个有方言意识的分类任务与具有挑战性的基因任务结合起来,为阿拉伯语的情绪理解和情绪操纵提供了统一的基准. 这一双重重点旨在刺激超越地表极度检测的研究,而转向阿拉伯语更加集成和可控制的语言技术。

blocks.en: 3.1 Subtask 1: Dialect Sentiment Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.1 分任务1:糖尿病感知分析

blocks.en: The dataset for this task, Multi-Dialect-Sent (MDS-3), currently consists of 3,000 sentences annotated for three-class sentiment (positive, negative, neutral). The dataset is balanced across five major dialects: Moroccan, Egyptian, Lebanese, Jordanian, and Saudi. The data was sourced from hotel reviews from the ADOR dataset ( Alharbi et al., 2025b ) , then translated and annotated by native speakers of each dialect. The sentences are parallel across dialects, with balanced sentiment representation across all included dialects. An initial version of the dataset was verified in recently organised shared tasks Ahasis ( Alharbi et al., 2025a ) and AraSentEval ( Ezzini et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 此项任务的数据集"多发音-Sent"(MDS-3)目前由3000句注解为三等情绪(正,负,中). 数据集平衡了五大方言:摩洛哥语,埃及语,黎巴嫩语,约旦语和沙特语. 数据来源于ADOR数据集(Alharbi等人,2025年b)的酒店评论,然后由每种方言的母语翻译并作注释。 这些句子在方言之间是平行的,在所有包括的方言之间都有均衡的情绪代表. 最近组织的Ahasis(Alharbi等人,2025年a)和AraSentEval(Ezzini等人,2026年)共同任务中核实了数据集的初始版本。

blocks.en: The dataset was split into 80% for training and 20% for testing. The split was performed based on sentence IDs to ensure that parallel sentences remain in the same set, to prevent potential data leakage between the training and test sets.
blocks.zh: 数据集分为80%用于培训,20%用于测试。 拆分是根据句子ID进行的,以确保平行句子保持不变,防止培训与测试组之间可能的数据泄漏.

blocks.en: 3.2 Subtask 2: Sentiment Swap
blocks.zh: 3.2 第2分任务:定点交换

blocks.en: This subtask draws on a dataset built as an extension of MA’AKS ( Mughaus et al., 2026 ) , comprising a total of 9,647 sentence-pair instances. Each pair centers on a shared topic but conveys contrasting sentiment orientations, with one member expressing a positive stance and the other a negative one. Of the full collection, 5,331 instances (55.3%) carry a Negative label, while the remaining 4,316 (44.7%) are tagged Positive.
blocks.zh: 这一子任务利用了作为MA-AKS(Mughaus等,2026年)的扩展而建的数据集,包括总共9,647个句法例。 每一对都集中在一个共同的主题上,但传达出相反的情绪取向,其中一名成员表示积极的立场,另一名成员则表示消极的立场。 在全部收集中,有5 331例(55.3%)带有负标签,而其余的4 316例(44.7%)带有正标签。

blocks.en: Whereas the original MA’AKS resource was built predominantly around MSA, the present corpus is drawn entirely from regional Arabic dialects and spans four principal dialectal families: Gulf (5,893 pairs, 61.1% of the total), Levantine (1,655 pairs, 17.2%), Egyptian (1,561 pairs, 16.2%), and Maghrebi (538 pairs, 5.6%).
blocks.zh: MA-AKS最初的资源主要围绕管理事务协议建立,而目前的资源则完全取自阿拉伯语区域方言,跨越四个主要的方言家族: 海湾(5 893对,占总数的61.1%)、莱万丁(1 655对,占17.2%)、埃及(1 561对,占16.2%)和马格里布(538对,占5.6%)。

blocks.en: To ensure reliability, every pair passed through a rigorous validation process assessing fluency, semantic fidelity, and the correctness of the sentiment reversal. The corpus comes with fixed training, validation, and test partitions, requiring models to capture both the meaning and the sentiment structure of each sentence. These partitions consist of 6,752 pairs for training, 964 for validation, and 1,931 for testing.
blocks.zh: 为了确保可靠性,每对都经过严格的验证过程,评估流利,语义忠诚,情绪倒转的正确性. 教程有固定的训练、验证和测试分区,要求模型既能抓住每个句子的意义又能抓住情绪结构。 这些分区由6,752对用于训练,964对用于验证,1,931对用于测试.

blocks.en: 4 Task Description and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 任务说明和评价

blocks.en: In this section, we describe in detail the subtasks that define our shared task. Participants were allowed to participate in either one or both subtasks. The official evaluation was conducted on the CodaBench platform, an open-source platform designed to organize Artificial Intelligence benchmarks by defining tasks, including datasets, submission pipelines, and evaluation metrics. It provides an automated and transparent framework for evaluating system submissions.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详细描述了界定我们共同任务的分任务。 与会者获准参加一个或两个分任务。 正式评价是在Coda Bench平台上进行的,该平台是一个开源平台,旨在通过界定包括数据集、提交程序和评价衡量标准在内的任务来组织人工情报基准。 它为评价系统提交材料提供了一个自动化和透明的框架。

blocks.en: 4.1 Subtask 1: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 第1分任务:阿拉伯语糖尿病感知分析

blocks.en: In this subtask, participants are required to build a system that classifies the sentiment expressed in sentences written in five different and linguistically challenging Arabic dialects: Moroccan, Egyptian, Lebanese, Jordanian, and Saudi. The goal of this task is to evaluate the ability of models to handle dialectal variation in Arabic while accurately identifying the sentiment conveyed in each sentence.
blocks.zh: 在这个分任务中,参与者需要建立一个系统,将用5个不同语言和具有挑战性的阿拉伯语方言(摩洛哥语、埃及语、黎巴嫩语、约旦语和沙特语)所写的句子表达的情绪分类。 这项任务的目标是评价模型处理阿拉伯语方言变异的能力,同时准确识别每个句子中表达的情绪.

blocks.en: 4.2 Subtask 2: Arabic Sentiment Swap
blocks.zh: 4.2 第2分任务:阿拉伯语传感器交换

blocks.en: In the second subtask, participants are expected to design models able to generate a new sentence that expresses the opposite sentiment of a given sentence while preserving its original semantic content. The input sentences are written in one of several Arabic dialect groups: Maghreb, Egyptian, Gulf, and Levantine. This task evaluates a model’s ability to perform controlled sentiment transformation while maintaining semantic fidelity.
blocks.zh: 在第二个子任务中,预期参与者会设计出能够生成出新句子的模型,在保留其原始语义内容的同时表达出某一句子的相反情绪. 输入句用几个阿拉伯语方言组中的一个来写:马格里布语,埃及语,海湾语和莱万亭语. 这一任务评价了一个模型在保持语义忠诚的同时进行受控情绪转变的能力.

blocks.en: • Input : An Arabic sentence along with its original sentiment polarity. • Output : A rewritten Arabic sentence that preserves the main meaning of the input while expressing the opposite sentiment polarity. • Evaluation Metrics : The generated outputs are evaluated using both sentiment accuracy and text similarity metrics to ensure correct sentiment transfer while maintaining semantic consistency. – Sentiment Style Accuracy : A pre-trained sentiment classifier from CamelLab 2 2 2 CAMeL-Lab/bert-base-arabic-camelbert-da-sentiment is used to measure the percentage of generated sentences that correctly express the target polarity. – BLEU and chrF : These metrics are used to evaluate the degree of lexical and character-level similarity between the generated sentence and the reference sentence, providing an indication of semantic preservation.

blocks.zh: 5 参与系统

blocks.en: Across both subtasks, a total of 15 unique teams participated in the competition, with 16 system description papers submitted. Below, we describe the methodologies and system architectures proposed by the participating teams, categorized by subtask.
blocks.zh: 在两个分任务中,共有15支独特的队伍参加了比赛,提交了16份系统描述文件。 下面我们介绍各参与小组提出的按分任务分类的方法和系统架构。

blocks.en: 5.1 Subtask 1: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.1 第1分任务:阿拉伯糖尿病感知分析

blocks.en: Participating teams for Subtask 1 investigated a diverse range of pretrained transformer architectures, ensembling strategies, loss function formulations, and domain-adaptation techniques to tackle multi-dialect variation and zero-shot dialect transfer.
blocks.zh: 参与分任务1的团队调查了各种经过预先训练的变压器结构,综艺策略,丢失函数配方,以及处理多相变和零镜头方言转移的域调制技术.

blocks.en: • ALEXIS (Username: momen_ibrahim-870387 ) ( Ibrahim et al., 2026a ) : Ranked 1st overall with a Macro F1-score of 0.8667 . The team proposed an adversarial training and iterative self-training pipeline built on top of MARBERTv2. Specifically, they utilized the Fast Gradient Method (FGM) during fine-tuning to regularize the feature space against dialectal perturbations. To address zero-shot generalization on unlabelled dialects (notably Lebanese), they implemented a confidence-thresholded pseudo-labeling strategy that iteratively incorporated high-confidence test predictions back into training. • Axiom (Username: ajwad_hossain-867052 ) ( Hossain, 2026 ) : Ranked 2nd with a Macro F1-score of 0.8210 . They developed a dialect-aware ensemble framework combining MARBERTv2 and AraBERTv2. Their system utilized Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation, text normalization tailored to dialectal orthography, and an automated soft-voting probability aggregation scheme. • PTUK-NLP (Username: tasneemduridi-857223 ) ( Duridi et al., 2026 ) : Ranked 3rd with a Macro F1-score of 0.8174 . The team fine-tuned MARBERT with domain-specific cleaning pipelines. They demonstrated that representations learned from geographically and linguistically proximate Levantine variants (Jordanian) transfer effectively in a zero-shot fashion to Lebanese. They also provided an extensive qualitative error analysis identifying mixed-polarity reviews as the primary source of classification errors. • NU-SentEval (Username: habiba_ayman-867381 ) ( Ayman et al., 2026 ) : Ranked 4th with a Macro F1-score of 0.8140 . They developed a stacked model blending predictions from MARBERTv2, AraBERTv02, and QARiB. Crucially, they integrated Focal Loss during training to mitigate class imbalance and focus gradient updates on hard-to-classify neutral examples. • Gradient Descenders (Username: normalman159-857755 ) ( Nhan et al., 2026 ) : Ranked 5th with a Macro F1-score of 0.8010 . The team performed an empirical comparison across multiple Arabic encoders (MARBERT, ARBERT, and AraBERT), concluding that fine-tuned MARBERTv2 combined with class-weighted cross-entropy loss and linear learning-rate warm-up yielded optimal multi-dialect performance. • LahjaSensei (Username: ahmadalmoustafa-856400 ) ( Almoustafa, 2026 ) : Ranked 6th with a Macro F1-score of 0.7977 . They utilized fine-tuned transformer backbones accompanied by dialect-specific token normalization and prompt-based tuning. • NAMAA Community (Username: mona_-871069 / hsnhb7 ) ( Abdelazim et al., 2026 ) : Ranked 7th with a Macro F1-score of 0.7953 . They constructed an ensemble merging MARBERTv2, AraBERTv2, and AraModernBERT, using dialect classification heads to dynamically weigh base-model outputs. • faisalm93 (Username: faisalm93-869067 ) ( Adam, 2026 ) : Ranked 8th with a Macro F1-score of 0.7939 . The author developed a 5-fold cross-validated MARBERTv2 bagging ensemble utilizing soft voting across fold models, Cosine Annealing learning rate schedules, and layer-wise learning rate decay. • Lahja (Username: shadenalzeer-867546 ) ( Alzeer, 2026 ) : Ranked 10th with a Macro F1-score of 0.7894 . They implemented a multi-seed ensembled MARBERT architecture designed to stabilize zero-shot transfer for the unrepresented Lebanese dialect by exploiting cross-dialect semantic regularities. • Northwestern (Username: monmon2000 ) ( Shlkamy and Zaghouani, 2026 ) : Explored a comparative study of MARBERTv2 and AraBERT under various dialectal splits, demonstrating that dialect-specific pretraining provides significant robustness gains over general MSA models.

blocks.en: 5.2 Subtask 2: Arabic Sentiment Swap
blocks.zh: 5.2 第2分任务:阿拉伯语传感器交换

blocks.en: Subtask 2 saw participating systems leverage generative large language models (LLMs), parameter-efficient adapters, candidate reranking pipelines, and preference alignment techniques to tackle the complex dual objective of sentiment polarity inversion and semantic fidelity.
blocks.zh: 次级任务2看到参与系统利用基因大语言模型(LLMs),参数效率适配器,候选再排位管,以及偏好对接技术,以解决情绪极性倒置和语义忠诚这一复杂的双重目标.

blocks.en: • ALEXIS (Username: momen_ibrahim-870527 ) ( Ibrahim et al., 2026b ) : Ranked 1st across all evaluation metrics, achieving a Sentiment Style Accuracy of 0.9581 , a BLEU score of 56.91 , and a chrF of 72.18 . They introduced a multi-stage framework combining: (1) dialect-aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using semantic similarity over training pairs, (2) Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align open-weight generative backbones towards clean polarity transfer, and (3) a classifier-guided candidate reranker that filters out candidates failing the target sentiment direction. • AKARROUCH (Username: akarrouch-871040 ) ( Akarrouch, 2026 ) : Ranked 2nd with a Sentiment Style Accuracy of 0.7851 , BLEU of 49.82 , and chrF of 70.12 . The system employed a generate-and-rerank architecture where an instruction-tuned LLM produced multiple candidate rewrites via temperature sampling, followed by a fine-tuned sentiment classifier to select the candidate maximizing target polarity probability. • LahjaSensei (Username: ahmadalmoustafa-865064 ) ( Almoustafa, 2026 ) : Ranked 3rd with a Sentiment Style Accuracy of 0.7789 , BLEU of 41.48 , and chrF of 64.45 . They proposed few-shot in-context prompting combined with Model Merging via Spherical Linear Interpolation (SLERP) across fine-tuned dialect checkpoints. • NAMAA (Username: mona_-871054 / hsnhb7-868552 ) ( Barmandah et al., 2026 ) : Ranked 4th with a Sentiment Style Accuracy of 0.7597 , BLEU of 51.58 , and chrF of 71.02 . The team introduced a cross-backbone ensembling framework combining candidate hypotheses from Qwen2.5, Llama-3, and AraT5, reranked by an auxiliary sentiment verification classifier. • Sabaa (Username: mohamedsabaa-855812 ) ( Sabaa and Said, 2026 ) : Ranked 6th with a Sentiment Style Accuracy of 0.7447 , BLEU of 49.07 , and chrF of 69.33 . They utilized fine-tuned AraT5 sequence-to-sequence models combined with an external MARBERT-based sentiment classifier to rerank beam-search hypotheses. • NU-SentEval (Username: areejkhaled-868894 ) ( Tamer et al., 2026 ) : Ranked 8th with a Sentiment Style Accuracy of 0.6898 , achieving a top-tier chrF of 72.61 and BLEU of 54.63 . blocks.en: Several key findings emerge from the experimental outcomes of Subtask 1:
blocks.zh: 次级任务1的实验结果产生了若干关键结果:

blocks.en: 1. Pretrained Dialectal Encoders Outperform Generative LLMs : All top-performing submissions relied on dedicated dialectal encoder models—most notably MARBERTv2 and AraBERTv02. Models exposed to substantial dialectal social media data during pretraining consistently outperformed general Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) baselines and zero-shot prompting of large generative models. 2. Robustness via Adversarial Training and Pseudo-Labeling : The winning system, ALEXIS , achieved a substantial lead (+4.57% Macro F1 over 2nd place). This gain was primarily driven by Fast Gradient Method (FGM) adversarial training, which forces the model representations to remain invariant to dialectal surface lexical variations, paired with iterative self-training that effectively bootstrapped representations for the unlabelled Lebanese test instances. 3. Ensembling and Loss Engineering : Teams that implemented stratified K K -fold ensembling ( Axiom , faisalm93 ) and model stacking across distinct pretraining families ( NU-SentEval , NAMAA ) demonstrated higher stability. Furthermore, incorporating Focal Loss ( NU-SentEval ) effectively addressed the subtle semantic boundaries between neutral and mildly opinionated dialectal phrases. 4. Zero-Shot Levantine Transferability : Analysis by PTUK-NLP and Lahja showed that models trained on geographically proximate dialects (Jordanian) exhibit strong zero-shot cross-lingual transfer to Lebanese, confirming shared lexical roots within the Levantine dialect family.

blocks.en: Evaluating generative sentiment swapping across Arabic dialects revealed several critical insights:
blocks.zh: 对跨阿拉伯语方言的基因感交换的评价揭示出几个关键见解:

blocks.en: 1. The Polarity Transfer vs. Content Preservation Trade-off : Generative sentiment style transfer poses an intrinsic tension between modifying sentiment markers (necessary for high Sentiment Style Accuracy) and retaining non-sentiment lexical content (measured by BLEU and chrF). Submissions that modified too few words achieved high BLEU but failed to invert sentiment (e.g., lower accuracy), while unconstrained generative rewrites suffered severe lexical drift. 2. The Impact of Preference Optimization (DPO) : The winning team, ALEXIS , dominated across all dimensions (0.9581 accuracy, 56.91 BLEU, 72.18 chrF). By directly training on paired contrastive preferences using DPO, their system learned to apply minimal, surgical edits to dialectal sentiment words (e.g., negating adjectives or swapping affective idioms) while strictly preserving sentence structure. 3. Generate-and-Rerank Pipelines as an Essential Safety Mechanism : Teams employing generate-and-rerank pipelines ( AKARROUCH , NAMAA , Sabaa ) achieved consistently higher style transfer accuracy ( > 74 % >74\% ) than unguided generation. Filtering candidate rewrites with an external sentiment classifier prevented output hallucination and ensured the target polarity was reliably achieved. 4. Model Merging and PEFT for Dialect Specialization : Advanced parameter-efficient techniques, such as SLERP model merging across dialect checkpoints ( LahjaSensei ) and Low-Rank Adaptation ( NileNLP ), proved competitive while requiring substantially lower computational footprints during fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This overview paper presented the results and findings of the DialectSentEval shared task, held at ArabicNLP 2026. The shared task benchmarked two core dimensions of dialectal NLP: multi-class Arabic dialect sentiment classification (Subtask 1) and generative sentiment style transfer across four major Arabic dialect groups (Subtask 2).
blocks.zh: 这份概览文件介绍了在2026年阿拉伯NLP举行的DialectSentEval共同任务的结果和结论。 共同任务以方言NLP的两个核心维度为基准:多级阿拉伯语方言情绪分类(分任务1)和分族情绪风格在四大阿拉伯语方言组之间的转移(分任务2).

blocks.en: A total of 15 teams actively participated in the competition. The evaluation demonstrated the continued superiority of dialect-pretrained masked encoders when paired with adversarial regularization and self-training for classification, as well as the immense potential of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and classifier-guided reranking for controlled generative style transfer in low-resource and dialectally diverse environments.
blocks.zh: 共有15支球队积极参与了比赛. 评估表明,与对抗性规范化和分类自我培训相配对的方言预设口罩编码器仍然具有优越性,而且直接偏好优化(DPO)和分级制重新排序在低资源和方言多样的环境中进行受控基因风格转移具有巨大潜力。
